messages:
Mara: Quick sync — want to lock the benchmark narrative and the lead-routing plan for the launch post + mini webinar. Draft charts attached in figma link: https://figma.com/s/benchmark-hooks
Alex: got it. main ask: one chart that non-technical PMs grok (latency -> dollars) and one that convinces infra teams (throughput/cost per 1k tokens).
Sam: For infra teams I still prefer a small table + violin for tail latency. violin shows variance which is what ops care about.
Jen: Agree on two charts. For the marketing post headline we should lead with an easy-to-scan claim: "Same quality, 3x lower inference cost at median latency" — then link to the deeper charts.
Priya: Love the headline. Can we get a short 1-liner subhead that hints at routing/fallbacks so enterprise buyers see reliability: "Predictable latency, configurable fallbacks for production"?
Noah: From product side, add a short footnote about how we measure tokens (prompt+completion) and that Dedicated numbers assume reserved pools. Avoid comparing to other vendors by name.
Alex: Noted. For the cost chart variant A we show cost per 1k tokens on y-axis, model latency on x-axis, color by deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Variant B is a stacked area showing total cost vs. throughput for common request sizes. Which should be the lead visual?
Mara: Lead visual: scatter (variant A) — intuitive. Secondary: stacked area for traffic planning. Sam: I'll build the violin as a tertiary toggle in the interactive embed.
Jen: Webinar ask: 30-min slot. 10m quick claim + demo, 10m deep dive into charts/why they matter, 10m Q&A. We need a clear CTA: "Try our benchmark with your workload" + an inbound form field that captures expected requests/sec and compliance needs.
Priya: CTA copy: "Run your workload on Redwood — we'll show expected latency & unit cost in 48 hours." Short and action oriented.
Noah: For lead routing — if expected RPS >= 50 OR compliance needs includes "SOC2/PCI/HIPAA", route to Enterprise queue in SFDC. Else route to Growth. Also tag leads with chart_variant_interest (latency, cost, throughput).
Alex: Which SFDC fields? we need exact field names for automation. Sam: Use: Expected_RPS__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Interest_Tags__c, Source__c (webinar). We already have automation ready in Zapier -> SFDC mapping.
Mara: Can marketing add two additional hidden form fields: Demo_Priority__c (auto set if Expected_RPS__c >= 50) and Benchmark_Variant__c (user picks latency/cost).
Priya: I'll write the landing copy and form wording today. Need the charts CSV (median, p95, p99, cost_per_1k, deployment_mode, tokens_per_request). Sam: I'll export CSV by EOW and post it here.
Noah: Decision: headline + scatter lead visual, violin as interactive toggle, webinar 30m schedule, SFDC routing rules as above. Everyone ok?
Alex: ok from growth.
Sam: ok — will upload CSV and figma frames.
Jen: ok, I'll start a short invite list (PMs, infra leads, solutions engineers). Mara: I'll queue the launch post draft for review tomorrow morning.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested for 2026-04-15 17:00 UTC. Please confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed for 04-15. Scheduling invite and ops runbook next.
Jen: I'll prep 3 quick audience-specific blurbs for outreach (PMs, Infra, Platform).
Priya: Draft landing copy will include the one-liner, 3 bullets (cost, latency, reliability), and the CTA. Will ping when ready for review.
Sam: CSV link (placeholder): https://internal.storage/redwood/benchmarks/bench_A_export.csv
Mara: Great work team — action items: Sam export CSV, Priya landing copy, Jen invites, Alex coordinate growth comms, Noah confirm SFDC field mappings. Check back in this thread with updates. :thumbsup:
